news.title: Boldly Forward: Donors Contribute More Than $31 Million To Advance Boldly Butler Priorities in 2025-2026
news.summary_en: Butler University concluded its 2025-2026 fiscal year on May 31 with $31,039,138 total dollars contributed from 12,802 individual donors. After welcoming the third-largest incoming class in University history, a major highlight of the year was the September 2025 public launch of the Boldly Butler strategy and accompanying comprehensive campaign.
